ProxyList.description_en: The proxies that are generated by the secure access proxy feature

CreatorId.description_zh: 安全访问代理创建人的用户ID

CreatorName.description_zh: 安全访问代理创建人的用户昵称

HttpsPort.description_en: The number of the port that was used by HTTPS clients to connect to the database instance

PrivateEnable.description_en: Indicates whether the internal endpoint is enabled. Default value: true
PrivateEnable.description_zh: 是否开启内网。默认返回值为true

ProtocolPort.description_zh: 数据库协议连接端口号
ProtocolPort.title_en: 数据库协议连接端口号
ProtocolPort.title_zh: 数据库协议连接端口号

ProtocolType.description_en: The type of the database. Example: MYSQL

ProxyId.description_en: The ID of the secure access proxy

PublicEnable.description_en:
Indicates whether the public endpoint is enabled. Valid values:

true: The public endpoint is enabled.
false: The public endpoint is disabled
PublicEnable.description_zh:
是否开启公网，返回值如下：

true：启用
false：禁用

PublicHost.description_en:
The public endpoint. A public endpoint is returned no matter whether the public endpoint is enabled or disabled.



If the value of the PublicEnable parameter is true, a valid public endpoint that can be resolved by using Alibaba Cloud DNS (DNS) is returned.

If the value of the PublicEnable parameter is false, an invalid public endpoint that cannot be resolved by using DNS is returned
PublicHost.description_zh:
公网地址，公网地址始终都会返回。

当公网地址的开启状态为true时，此处返回的公网地址为有DNS解析能力的有效地址。
当公网地址的开启状态为false时，此处返回的公网地址为无DNS解析能力的无效地址

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：

true：请求成功
false：请求失败
